name: Bureau of Indian Standards
description: Publishes the National Building Code of India (NBC) and IS fire/safety codes referenced in building and fire design.

name: State Fire and Emergency Services Department
description: State-level authority issuing Fire NOC (No Objection Certificate) and enforcing state Fire Prevention and Life Safety Acts/Rules.

name: Directorate/Chief Inspectorate of Factories and Boilers
description: State authority enforcing the Factories Act and workplace occupational safety compliance for warehousing/industrial premises.

name: Central Pollution Control Board / State Pollution Control Board
description: National/state body regulating hazardous waste, solid waste, effluent, and emission compliance.

name: Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation
description: National regulator for storage and handling of petroleum products, compressed gases, and hazardous/flammable materials.

name: Health and Safety Executive
description: UK national regulator for workplace health, safety, and major accident hazard compliance.

name: Local Fire and Rescue Authority (Home Office oversight)
description: Local Fire and Rescue Authority enforcing the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 and carrying out fire safety audits.

name: Environment Agency
description: UK regulator for environmental permitting, waste management, and pollution control.
